page.overview:
What is City Harbour?

City Harbour is a subtheme of City with the first sets released in June–July 2011. The subtheme focuses on harbour sceneries. Even though the subtheme was released in 2011, an earlier version of a harbour set that is 4645 Harbour has been released in 2007 as set 7994 LEGO City Harbor but that harbour is in the Transportation subtheme. It is now available in the US and the UK.
